title: The textual-smoke test asserts exactly 2 occurrences of `planApproval: setupArg…
body: The textual-smoke test asserts exactly 2 occurrences of `planApproval: setupArgs.planApproval` in index.ts. This is the blessed two-layer precedent (mirrors no-permission-mode-flag.test.ts), but it is coupled to the current shape: a future refactor extracting the shared options-literal into one helper would legitimately drop the count to 1 and fail. Non-blocking; a behavioral assertion on runSetup/collectSetupAnswers short-circuit would be more refactor-durable.
